description: Deliver shared coding-agent lifecycle events to the local Chorus daemon.

hooks.command: CHORUS_HOOK_SOURCE=$([ -n "${CODEX_HOME:-}" ] && echo codex || echo claude) CHORUS_HOOK_EVENT=Stop "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/chorus-hook"
CHORUS_HOOK_SOURCE=$([ -n "${CODEX_HOME:-}" ] && echo codex || echo claude) CHORUS_HOOK_EVENT=SubagentStop "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/chorus-hook"
CHORUS_HOOK_SOURCE=$([ -n "${CODEX_HOME:-}" ] && echo codex || echo claude) CHORUS_HOOK_EVENT=PreToolUse "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/chorus-hook"
CHORUS_HOOK_SOURCE=$([ -n "${CODEX_HOME:-}" ] && echo codex || echo claude) CHORUS_HOOK_EVENT=PostToolUse "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/chorus-hook"
CHORUS_HOOK_SOURCE=$([ -n "${CODEX_HOME:-}" ] && echo codex || echo claude) CHORUS_HOOK_EVENT=UserPromptSubmit "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/chorus-hook"
CHORUS_HOOK_SOURCE=$([ -n "${CODEX_HOME:-}" ] && echo codex || echo claude) CHORUS_HOOK_EVENT=SessionStart "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/chorus-hook"
